details: Germany's biggest EDM festival on the Neustadt-Glewe airfield between Berlin and Hamburg; the 2026 edition had a record 210,000 visits. 2027 is the 25th anniversary with an extra festival day (7-11 July) and the theme "We bring Australia to Germany". Tickets on sale in limited phases; line-up not announced yet. Camping festival.
